label: Mufti OEE reference: dim_reason
info: Writes the reference table dim_reason to the data lake. Read calls only against Insights Hub.

name: [1] TRIGGER & CONFIG
info: STAGE 1 - TRIGGER AND CONFIG. Writes the table dim_reason to the data lake. Schedule: weekly, Monday 07:00 UTC. The Run now button starts it by hand. Both go through 1.1 CONFIG, the only node to edit: output path, dry-run switch, credentials, asset list. dryRun is true by default: set it to false to write the file. The file name is fixed, so every run replaces the file.

name: 1.1 CONFIG (edit here)
1.2 Build run message
[2] SETUP
info: STAGE 2 - token request, OEE asset list, choose the assets. Function nodes cannot use fetch in the VFC, so every call is an http request node: the function before it sets msg.method, msg.url and msg.headers. A failure goes to the LOG and nothing is written.

name: 2.1 Build token request
2.2 Build asset list request
2.3 Choose assets
[3] REASON TREES
info: STAGE 3 - The reason tree id of every asset comes with the OEE asset list. Keep the distinct ids, read the list of trees for the names, then one message per tree.

name: 3.1 Pick ids
3.2 Build master list request
3.3 Choose ids
[4] REASONS
info: STAGE 4 - One message per tree. GET the flat reason list (parentId) and build level, top level name and full path. The result goes to the join ("to JOIN").

name: 4.1 Build detail request
4.2 Build rows
[5] JOIN & DECIDE
info: STAGE 5 - The join waits for all items. Collect puts the rows in one list. Decide writes NOTHING if any item failed (no half tables) and nothing in dry-run mode. Output 1 = the rows for the parquet node, output 2 = the log.

name: 5.1 Collect rows
5.2 Decide write
[6] WRITE dim_reason
info: STAGE 6 - parquet node, path and write object for dim_reason. The path comes from CONFIG. Types: UTF8 (STRING), BOOLEAN, INT64, DOUBLE, TIMESTAMP_MILLIS (epoch ms).

name: 6.1 Set path
[7] LOG
info: STAGE 7 - LOG. Every log line arrives here through the link "to LOG": one line per run (debug sidebar): row count, skipped assets, FAILED / NOTHING WRITTEN, or the dry-run row count and first rows.
